1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronSourceBudget
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronCutTreeCharts
3 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutTreeChainPaths
4 
5 /-! Global kite separation for the six-vertex universal-source star.
6 Every kite is placed in the same fixed plane; its angle budget has been
7 proved from the original faces rather than a prescribed graph model. -/
8 
9 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
10 
11 open Set Real
12 
13 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (six : P.vertices.card = 6)
14   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
15     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
16   {a : frontier P.body} (T : P.CutLocusTree a) (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
17   (source : P.Vertex) (universal : ∀ v : P.Vertex, v ≠ source → P.edgeGraph.Adj source v)
18   (at_source : (a : Space) = (source : Space))
19 
20 include six small_faces universal at_source in
21 /-- Every simple chain fits within the actual source-angle budget. -/
22 theorem universal_cut_tree_chain_source_budget {n : ℕ} (chain : CutTreeChain T n) :
23     (∑ i, chain.sourceAngle charts i) < π := by
24   classical
25   letI : Fintype P.Face := Fintype.ofFinite P.Face
26   letI : Fintype T.vertices := T.finite_vertices.fintype
27   letI : DecidableRel T.graph.Adj := Classical.decRel _
28   let models (d : T.graph.Dart) := (charts.triangles d.adj).model
29   let selected := Finset.univ.image chain.dart
30   have no_reverse : ∀ d ∈ selected, d.symm ∉ selected := by
31     rintro d member reverse
32     obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp member
33     obtain ⟨j, _, same⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp reverse
34     exact chain.dart_ne_reverse i j same.symm
35   have bound := (T.selected_source_angle_sum_le_half models selected no_reverse).trans_lt
36     (universal_half_source_angle_sum_lt_pi small_faces T models six source universal at_source)
37   have sum_eq : (∑ d ∈ selected, (models d).sourceAngle) = ∑ i, chain.sourceAngle charts i := by
38     rw [Finset.sum_image]
39     · rfl
40     · exact fun _ _ _ _ same => chain.dart_injective same
41   rwa [sum_eq] at bound
42 
43 include six small_faces universal at_source in
44 /-- Distinct actual tree-edge kites have disjoint interiors in the common development. -/
45 theorem universal_global_kites_nonoverlap
46     {u v w z : T.vertices} (first : T.graph.Adj u v) (last : T.graph.Adj w z)
47     (different : s(u, v) ≠ s(w, z)) :
48     Disjoint (charts.kite first) (interior (charts.kite last)) := by
49   obtain ⟨n, chain, first_same, last_same⟩ := T.exists_chain_between_edges first last different
50   have first_image : charts.kite (chain.edge 0) = charts.kite first :=
51     charts.kite_eq_of_same_edge _ first first_same
52   have last_image : charts.kite (chain.edge (Fin.last n).succ) = charts.kite last :=
53     charts.kite_eq_of_same_edge _ last last_same
54   rw [← first_image, ← last_image]
55   exact chain.end_kites_nonoverlap charts
56     (universal_cut_tree_chain_source_budget six small_faces T charts source universal at_source chain)
57 
58 include six small_faces universal at_source in
59 /-- Construct the full covering chart collection with every pair of kites separated. -/
60 theorem universal_exists_separated_cut_tree_charts :
61     ∃ charts : CutTreeCharts T,
62       ∀ {u v w z : T.vertices} (first : T.graph.Adj u v) (last : T.graph.Adj w z),
63         s(u, v) ≠ s(w, z) → Disjoint (charts.kite first) (interior (charts.kite last)) := by
64   obtain ⟨charts⟩ := small_universal_source_cut_tree_charts (show P.vertices.card ≤ 6 by omega)
65     small_faces a source at_source universal T
66   exact ⟨charts, fun first last different =>
67     universal_global_kites_nonoverlap six small_faces T charts source universal at_source first last different⟩
68 
69 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
